purpose: Портреты двух новых записей CR1 MM14; передача в public и регистрация прав выполняются владельцем интеграции.
generation_policy: original_generated_art; one asset per call; no dnd.su gallery image copied; staging only until catalog integration
rights_note_ru: Портреты сгенерированы отдельно от dnd.su. Root должен скопировать staged PNG в public/assets/enemies/dnd-2014 и зарегистрировать их в data/asset-rights.json.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: tabletop RPG bestiary portrait, square 512x512 source
Primary request: an original dark-fantasy portrait of a mischievous imp devil for a 2014 fantasy RPG bestiary
Scene/backdrop: smoky shadowed infernal chamber with subtle ember glow, simple dark background
Subject: one small horned imp with batlike wings, clawed hands, sly alert expression, clearly readable silhouette
Style/medium: painterly dark fantasy concept art, detailed but clean enough for a small game portrait
Composition/framing: centered bust or three-quarter figure, face and torso prominent, generous margin on every side for circular cropping
Lighting/mood: dramatic warm rim light against cool charcoal shadows, ominous and cunning
Color palette: charcoal, deep crimson, muted bronze, restrained ember orange
Materials/textures: leathery wings, rough skin, small horns, smoky atmosphere
Text (verbatim): ""
Constraints: one creature only; original artwork; circular-safe composition; no text; no border; no frame; no watermark; no logo
Avoid: multiple creatures, humanoid hero, giant demon, photorealism, bright empty background, cropped horns or wings, symbols, letters
assets.notes_ru: Проверен визуально; один читаемый силуэт беса, без надписей и рамки, квадрат 512×512.
